svg.title: Full pipeline flow: 7 CSV files to Athena warehouse
svg.desc: End-to-end data pipeline from 7 source CSV files through S3 raw, ETL transformation, to Glue Catalog and Athena warehouse

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Giải thích chi tiết operator_A CSV: schema, event_code, attribution logic')
sendPrompt('Giải thích operator_B CSV: SUB/REN/UNSUB, rotate_id null design')
sendPrompt('Giải thích operator_C CSV: tracking_code, DELIVERED, SMS parser bug')
sendPrompt('campaigns.csv: schema và vai trò trong pipeline')
sendPrompt('clicks.csv: rotate_id, campaign_id, attribution bridge')
sendPrompt('tracking_codes.csv và page_events.csv: vai trò trong operator_C attribution và funnel flags')
sendPrompt('Giải thích chi tiết Stage 1 Ingest: loaders.py, validate, write S3 Parquet')
g.text: Read CSV → cast types → validate null rate → write S3 Parquet raw layer

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Giải thích S3 raw layer layout: operator_a/date=.../data.csv, static/ prefix')
sendPrompt('Giải thích Stage 2 build_dim_campaigns: SCD-0, mode=overwrite, raw_campaigns → dim_campaigns')
g.text: raw_campaigns → rename id→campaign_id → dedup → dim_campaigns (SCD-0, mode=overwrite)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Giải thích chi tiết build_fct_subscriptions: attribution 3 operators, tracking_code 30min window, quarantine logic')
sendPrompt('Giải thích build_fct_billing: event_code=2 op_A, REN op_B, billing_sequence window function, is_first_bill')
sendPrompt('Giải thích build_fct_clicks: page_event flags pivot, has_subscription, has_first_bill join')
sendPrompt('Giải thích fct_unattributed_events: 3 reasons quarantine, SMS parser bug, tracking_code_too_long')
sendPrompt('Giải thích build_mart_daily_performance: groupby campaign, conversion rates, revenue aggregation, granularity')
g.text: GROUP BY campaign_id · clicks / subs / revenue / rates

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Giải thích S3 warehouse layout: raw/, dimensions/, facts/, mart/ prefix, Parquet partition by report_date')
sendPrompt('Giải thích Stage 5 quality checks: 8 checks, SNS alert, QualitySuite, attribution rate 80%')
g.text: row counts · no duplicates · no negative rev

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Giải thích SNS alert: khi nào gửi, format message, topic ARN setup')
sendPrompt('Giải thích Athena query: adstart_warehouse database, query syntax, awswrangler read_sql_query, cost per scan')
sendPrompt('Ai consume Athena output? BI tools, dashboard, ad-hoc SQL, downstream reports')
sendPrompt('Giải thích Prefect orchestration: flow, task, retry, schedule 06:00 UTC, deployment daily/backfill')
